items.title: Mortgage Rates On 3-Day Winning Streak, But the Prize Is Small

items.content: Mortgage rates are slightly better again today, marking the third successive day of gains. But we’re talking tiny moves, in fact, the tiniest of moves. items.title: Mortgage Rates in Limbo With Nvidia Earnings on Deck
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Mortgage rates are flat today, still hovering around 7.50% for the average 30-year fixed. The 10-year Treasury yield, which mortgage rates follow, remains around 5.10%, as October retail sales came in line with expectations.
